## Types and classes

### Types

```{r}
typeof(1.5)
typeof("toto")
typeof(TRUE)
typeof(1L)
typeof(1)
typeof(typeof)
typeof(list())
```

### Classes

```{r}
data(iris)
typeof(iris)
class(iris)
```

## Vectors 

Many things in R are vectors(and most of the other things are lists)

A vector is a collection of values of the same type (possibly a single value)

```{r}
x <- 15.25
length(x)
x[1]

```


```{r}
length(length(x))
typeof(length(x))
```


```{r}
y <- c(1,6,90,-34,1.5,18,1e-12)
y
typeof(y)
y[2]
length(y)
```

c function can be seen as a creation function or, more accurately, as a vector concatenetion function

```{r}
c(x,y)
```
